newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mobutu appears before reporters, doesn't speak.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu appears before reporters, doesn't speak.

text.p: Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko, recuperating from prostate cancer surgery at his French Riviera villa, appeared before reporters on Wednesday and a Zairean diplomat said he was getting better.

"The president will go back home in the next few days. The situation demands it," Zairean ambassador to France Baya Ramazini told a handful of reporters invited in to the villa to see Mobutu, who did not speak during his brief appearance.
Mobutu has been out of Zaire since August, seeking treatment for his cancer in Switzerland. He left Switzerland for his French villa on Monday.

He has remained silent since fighting broke out in his country between Zairean troops and Rwandan-backed Tutsi rebels, trapping more than one million starving refugees and threatening the government's hold on northeastern Zaire.
"The president is getting much better but he is still convalescing and has resumed a bit of activity in light of the situation in his country," Ramazini told reporters.

He said Mobutu was following developments in Zaire through regular contacts with senior government officials including Prime Minister Kengo wa Dondo. All government actions were taken in agreement with the president, he said.
